tw-mn-warsaw-murphy-crock-1920.st: The $6,000 crock lay under a rotten board in the barnyard of the Murphy farm near Faribault; the tradition went back to settler James Murphy.

tw-mi-bronson-gold-farm-1939.st: In Jan 1941 Judge Renshaw split the $3,000 found in 1939 half to the finders and half to the heirs of the former owners, who buried it before 1921. The AP account puts the $1,100 in a tin can under the front porch and adds a third cache of $100.
src: Kalamazoo Gazette, 21 Jan 1941, p. 4 (AP Coldwater; Newspapers.com 1157589602)
